lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 10 distinct high-contrast white vertical lines are visible. Spacing is variable, with wider gaps in the mid-torso region and increased frequency/narrower spacing toward the posterior rump.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The anterior-most line is abbreviated, terminating before reaching the ventral midline. Multiple posterior lines show segment fragmentation near the dorsal ridge.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A low-density grouping of 4 distinct white spots is visible on the upper posterior haunch, situated below the vertical line termini.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the lateral haunch align to form a semi-linear horizontal geometric arrangement.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white spot on the lower cheek; white chevron-like band across the nasal bridge; white patch on the lower throat; white band on the upper interior of the foreleg.
